effects: Pulls `amount` of the collateral token USBD (0x6bedE1c6…, checked against the constructor's InitParams) from the signer into the vault with safeTransferFrom (Vault.deposit).
Mints active vault shares, previewDeposit(depositedAmount), to `onBehalfOf`. The signer only gets them when onBehalfOf is the signer.
Reverts when the deposit whitelist is on and the signer is not whitelisted, or when the deposit limit would be passed. Nothing moves in those cases.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 USBD into the vault for the named beneficiary. The vault, amount and beneficiary are all shown as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to the beneficiary is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)` depends on storage. The descriptor shows only #.amount and #.onBehalfOf.
findings.fix: None needed. The share count is computed on chain from storage.

effects: Burns the signer's active shares, previewWithdraw(amount) rounded up, which lowers the signer's staked position by `amount` of USBD (Vault.withdraw, _withdraw).

Queues `amount` USBD for the epoch after the current one and gives withdrawal shares for it to `claimer`. Only the claimer can claim it later, so the signer gives up these funds when claimer is someone else.
No tokens move now. Funds become claimable only after the next epoch ends (epoch length 7 days), and they stay slashable until then.
formats.shown: Request a 2.5 USBD withdrawal from the vault, with the named address as claim owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned and the claim delay come from storage and are not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`. _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1`.
findings.fix: Optional: say in the intent that the funds can be claimed after the next epoch.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares (Vault.redeem, _withdraw).
Queues previewRedeem(shares) USBD for the epoch after the current one and gives withdrawal shares for it to `claimer`. Only the claimer can claim it later.
No tokens move now. The asset amount depends on the vault's current share-to-asset ratio.
formats.shown: Queue a raw share count (987654321123456789) for withdrawal, with the named address as claim owner. The USBD value is not given.

findings.title: redeem: shares appear as a raw 18-digit integer, in a field and in the interpolated intent.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem: `#.shares` format `raw`, interpolatedIntent "Queue {shares} raw shares for {claimer}". Case 2 screen: "Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares". ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares use the same 18-decimal scale as USBD.
findings.fix: Show #.shares with format `unit` and decimals 18 (base 'shares'), so the screen reads about 0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the USBD amount queued for the claimer is computed from storage and not shown.
findings.fix: Optional: name USBD in the intent, e.g. 'Queue USBD withdrawal of vault shares'.

effects: Sends the signer's matured USBD withdrawal for `epoch`, withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender), from the vault to `recipient` (Vault.claim, _claim).
Marks the signer's withdrawal for that epoch as claimed, which uses up the claim right.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch 42 to the named recipient. The asset and amount are not given.

findings.title: claim: the intent never names the asset (USBD) sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The descriptor intent is "Claim withdrawal" and interpolatedIntent "Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}". No field names USBD.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Claim USBD withdrawal' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim USBD withdrawal of epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the amount paid out comes from storage and cannot be shown.

effects: Sends the sum of the signer's matured USBD withdrawals for every listed epoch from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer (Vault.claimBatch, _claim).
Marks each listed epoch as claimed for the signer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the named recipient, with every epoch listed. The asset and total are not given.

findings.title: claimBatch: the intent never names the asset (USBD) sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The descriptor intent is "Claim withdrawals" and interpolatedIntent "Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".
findings.fix: Use intent 'Claim USBD withdrawals' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim USBD withdrawals of epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total paid out is summed from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i])`, where _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender).
